description: Use when a Salesforce Flow throws a runtime error, sends an unhandled fault email, or produces unexpected results in production or sandbox. Triggers: 'Flow error email', 'Flow failed at element', 'null reference in Flow', 'Flow SOQL limit error', 'Flow DML in loop error'. NOT for changing who receives fault emails or suppressing noisy ones — use flow/flow-error-notification-patterns. NOT for designing fault paths before anything fails — use flow/fault-handling. NOT for org-wide error alerting and trends — use flow/flow-error-monitoring.
inputs: Flow fault email content (stack trace and element name from the error notification)
Flow API name and version number
Record ID or scenario that triggers the error (if known)
name: flow-runtime-error-diagnosis
official_sources: Metadata API Developer Guide 264 — FlowSettings `enableFlowUseApexExceptionEmail` L120062-120067, `canDebugFlowAsAnotherUser` L119944-119947; FlowDefinition `activeVersionNumber` L76681
Object Reference 264 — FlowInterviewLog and FlowInterviewLogEntry (screen flows) L140750, L140888; FlowInterview.InterviewStatus L140657-140666
Apex Developer Guide 264 — per-transaction limits L19747, L19757, L19749; lock wait L9395-9398
Salesforce Help — Debug a Flow in Flow Builder — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.flow_test_debug.htm
Apex Developer Guide — Execution Governors and Limits — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.apexcode.meta/apexcode/apex_gov_limits.htm
outputs: Root cause identification from the fault email and debug log
Specific element and variable that caused the failure
Fix recommendation or fault path handler configuration
